**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or non-compete covenant. I searched for every detection trigger — "solicit", "hire", "employ or engage", "induce", "recruit", "personnel", "non-compete", "directly or indirectly" — and the only hits were in the indemnity provisions (third parties "hired by, employed, retained or under... control"), the confidentiality provision (permitted disclosure to employees and directors), and the limitation-of-liability carve-out. The single employment-related general provision is the independent-contractor clause at p0066.

Since AP is subject to no restrictive covenant on hiring Kubient personnel, this sits at the playbook's **preferred** position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), not merely the fallback. No edit is warranted.
